rows.notes: Transcript 'atta!' (found it) makes little sense in the dodge/attack slot (Canaria's 005 is 'Useless!'); may be 'atari'/'hazure'. Neutral 'There!' chosen.
kono kuso! - Bobby's rough male register.
Transcript 'rea' - an attack shout (likely 'orya!'), no words.

rows.en: Oh my, looks like I got hit.

rows.notes: suki darake ne (full of openings) heard as 'suki daro ke ne'; Canaria's 020 is the same line.
Heard 'tamaa morottaa'; read as tama moratta (slang: 'I'll take your life').
icchou yatte yaru ze, rough register.

rows.en: Am I not good enough for you?
rows.notes: Flirting with an enemy: 'not satisfied with me as your opponent?'

rows.en: I'll keep your eyes glued on me.

rows.notes: Heard 'oujo senryaku' (princess strategy); read as oujou seiya! (yakuza 'die!') - a 3.3 s shout.

rows.en: You're not much of a challenge.
I'm sorry, but this is fate.

rows.notes: Heard 'oide nasu to wa ne'; read as oide nasutta wa ne (so they've shown up).

rows.en: Looks like you couldn't handle my love.
A maiden should manage this much.
How dare you, my precious shield!

rows.notes: Heard 'besshaa shiro yo'; read as benshou shiro yo (pay me back for it) - shield destroyed slot.

rows.en: I don't mind a cheeky one.
rows.notes: Light damage; namaiki na ko - gender of the enemy unknown.

rows.en: That won't be enough to satisfy me.
I'm not the type who enjoys pain.
Doing whatever you please, are you?

rows.notes: Heard 'iya, shinkuuki' (vacuum); guessed iya, shitsukoi (ugh, persistent) in the heavy-damage slot. Could also be 'shinjirarenai'.

rows.en: Is this what they call a tight spot?
Don't think a little thing like this means you've won!
Think you can do whatever you want?!
Don't you dare look down on me!
Am I about to become a star in the sky?
rows.notes: Shot down; 'ohoshisama ni naru' = to die.

rows.en: I'll never forget your face, you bastard!
Damn it! Is this the end?!

rows.notes: wakai wa ne, to the partner.

rows.en: Show some guts, damn it! Guts!
That's what you get for being so reckless.
Honestly, you can't do a thing without me.

rows.notes: Ally shot down; 'they' singular, identity unknown.

rows.en: I'm sorry I couldn't protect you.
Don't get shot down without my permission!
Heh. A woman risks her life for love and work alike.
I should be able to handle a mission like this.
Oh no! We didn't make it in time?
I won't accept it! Not an ending like this!
An ending like this is just too cruel.
The tragic heroine role really suits me, huh?
Damn it all! I screwed up!
rows.notes: 'kuso ttara ka' read as kusottare ga.

rows.en: I'm counting on you for cover fire.

rows.notes: 'dandan' read as banban uchacchainasai (fire away freely).

rows.en: Charge in with all you've got!
